The switch window no longer closes by itself right after you open it.

**What changed**

- **The first click now works.** On some PCs the first click on the account button opened the switch window and it vanished at once; the second click worked. Hermes Desktop was rebuilding the button as the window opened, and the window forgot it was open. It now remembers.
- **Nothing else changed.** Switching, the accounts and the settings are the same as in 1.4.3.

**How it was checked:** an automated test rebuilds the button while the window is open; it fails on 1.4.3 and passes on 1.4.4. After release it was installed on a real PC where the first click had failed every time, and the window now stays open on the first click.

**After installing:** fully close Hermes Desktop and open it again.

The archive, its SHA-256 and the release gates are attached. Technical details are in `docs/release-notes.md`.
